memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness. - Gen 1:4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
After God made the light, He paused to look at it, and He declared it good. This little phrase tells us so much about our God. He is not careless or indifferent about what He makes. He looks, He delights, and He calls His work good. Everything that comes from God's hand carries His goodness.

Then God separated the light from the darkness. From the very start, God is a God of order. He does not leave things mixed and muddled; He divides, arranges, and sets each thing in its proper place. Light and darkness are not allowed to blur together. There is a clear line between them.

This gently speaks to us too. God still loves to bring order where there is confusion, and He still calls His people to walk in the light rather than the darkness (Eph 5:8). In Christ, we have been called out of darkness into His wonderful light (1 Pet 2:9).

If today you feel your life is a blur of light and shadow, remember that the God of order is patient and kind. He who saw that the light was good sees you, and He is at work, setting things in their right place. Nothing He makes is wasted, and nothing He begins is left unfinished.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do you sense God bringing order out of confusion in your life?
2. What might it look like for you to walk more fully in the light this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that everything You make is good. Bring Your order into my life, and help me walk in Your light each day. Amen.
